title: Leadership
heading: Leadership and Volunteer Experiences
intro: During my undergraduate and graduate program, I have volunteered and held leadership positions at a number of different organizations.

items.title: Communication Secretary - Bangladesh Students' Organization, Auburn University
items.details: Facilitated communication with 200 Bangladeshi students at Auburn through BSO. Organized and hosted several major cultural events with participation from a large number of international attendees.

items.title: Campus Sustainability Initiative, Jahangirnagar University
items.details: Collaborative research project between JU and the Asian Institute of Technology, Thailand to promote sustainability by quantifying and finding mitigation strategies for energy demand-based CO2 emissions. Initiated the project under the supervision of IPCC lead author Dr. Joyashree Roy.

items.title: Convener and Gold Award - The Duke of Edinburgh International Award Program
items.details: Awarded the Gold Award for personal development and social welfare activities, including cycling, community teaching, and adventurous journeys. Served as a convener at Jahangirnagar University for the team of 14 awardees.

items.title: Vice President - YouthMappers at IRS, Jahangirnagar University Chapter
items.details: Contributed to developing OpenStreetMap (OSM) by providing local data and building a volunteer team on campus. Collaborated with international OSM volunteers to organize training and webinars.

items.title: Founding Joint Secretary (2019-20) and General Secretary (2020-21) - Jahangirnagar University Higher Study Club (JUHSC)
items.details: Established the club and ensured its sustainability in the second term. Managed 5-20 people, organized many seminars as convener, and connected alumni globally. Still serving as an alumni advisor; the club now has more than 200 members.
